talks.title: Optimized Software Implementation of Keccak, Kyber, and Dilithium on RV{32,64}IM{B}{V} & ENG25519: Faster TLS 1.3 handshake using optimized X25519 and Ed25519
talks.location: School of Cyber Science and Technology, Shandong University (SDU), Qingdao, China

software.title: ST-Link patch for STM32G0/G1 series
software.description: A patch for ST-Link to support STM32G0B0/G0B1/G0C1/G050/G051/G061 microcontrollers.

projects.title: Curve25519 Optimization University & Enterprise Project
projects.description: Reduced the ROM occupancy of Curve25519 (X25519+Ed25519) from 70KB+ (OpenSSL) to less than 15KB (and under 10KB on target devices) for resource-constrained IoT devices (Cortex-M3 and RISC-V).

projects.title: SM2 Optimization Internship Project
projects.role: Intern (2021 Rhino-Bird Research Elite Training Program)
projects.description: Optimized the performance of SM2 (Chinese ECC Commercial Standard) on ARMv8-A Linux servers. Compared to OpenSSL, the performance of sign/verify was improved by 8.7X/3.5X on HUAWEI Cloud Kunpeng 920 platform.
